decision: withheld; corrective engine not accepted for main
protocol: Same corrected 76 configurations as e28; 120 Hz updates and 20 Hz passive measurements. All results freshly simulated. Finite-pressure control stops after the 16 development cases because it loses pressure and concedes more goals. Controls are source transformations of the immutable e28 fixture, not production code.
limitations: Synthetic, no real-match validation or xG
Potential windows are geometric opportunities, not predicted goals
Geometric rays omit height and body parts; access uses existing approximate arrivalTime to radius 1.65
Shared seed does not imply shared draws after decisions diverge
Pressure means tackle range and cooldown, not a guaranteed recovery
Intent changes include target movement, not necessarily tactical oscillation
Previously exposed scenarios: exploratory replication, not a new holdout
Observed-shot contact positives are checked against actual update; a null prediction does not prove physical impossibility
Initial/final coordinates are represented by a SHA256 for compact replication; adverse traces are stored separately
No new goalkeeper, attack or IFAB policy
